name: news-caption-slam
title: News Caption Slam
description: Captions-first social news on a plain or gradient backdrop: a kicker and a huge number in a yellow block that rolls up, then caption words slammed in one by one, a keyword wiped onto a block, a source tag and a second rolling number.
useWhen: A fact, a figure or a short announcement should land as big slammed captions, in the style of social news clips.
A small business, creator or class wants a stat with a source line, without needing footage.
avoidWhen: The captions must follow a spoken transcript word for word: use the caption-* blocks.
The tone is soft or premium: slammed type on a yellow block is loud on purpose.
author: Mosio
